description: Closed set of motion patterns. Every PageSpec node declares one primary pattern (plus optional `additional` patterns where the section contract allows) and the pattern's locked reducedMotionFallback. Optional fields (durationMs, intervalMs, easing, trigger), when present, must equal the measured values below. Global hover micro-interactions (200ms) are owned by primitives/button.json and are not declared per node.

none.description: No motion beyond global hover micro-interactions.

header-menus.description: Sign-in menu reveal (300ms out-expo, rows staggered 50/100/150ms) and drawer slide (300ms ease-out); nav dropdowns appear instantly.

carousel-crossfade.description: 10s autoplay per slide while >=50% in view; 500ms ease dissolve of copy and art; 2px progress fill (10s, progress easing); user selection or focus stops autoplay.

logo-fade-in.description: Each logo fades in once on mount.

logo-rotate.description: Every 2000ms one random cell fades out (500ms), stays blank, then fades in a logo not on screen (+1000ms).

video-viewport-gated.description: Illustrated demo loops while >=20% in view (IntersectionObserver [0, 0.2]); pauses out of view; manual play/pause control. Under reduced motion every illustration shows a complete static frame.

sticky-pinned-text.description: Text column translates against the scroll (pinned at the visible centre) and fades in/out over 200px; only >=640.02 under no-preference.

accordion-expand.description: Panel grid-rows 0fr<->1fr + opacity and caret -180deg over 200ms ease, motion-safe only.

floating-header-slide.description: Fixed plan header slides translateY(-110%)<->0 when the comparison header reaches 71px and until its end rises to 170px.

tooltip-fade.description: Tooltip mounts 200ms after hover/focus and fades in .2s; hides instantly.

smooth-scroll-anchor.description: Compare button smooth-scrolls to the comparison (behaviour 'auto' under reduced motion).

cta-art-drift.description: Slow CSS drift of the closing-CTA background art (stands in for the original's animated GIF); the static gradient remains under reduced motion.
